title: Sam Morgan, Buddy Petit and Punch Miller as trumpet men
summary: He ranks Punch, Sam Morgan, Buddy Petit and Rene above today's players, praising Sam Morgan's tone and head arrangements.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Trumpeters I admired: rating the horn players
